name: Grade

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 mention on site or in web search; company sells a B2B payroll/payouts API and markets itself on compliance ('Pay Your Creators and Stay Compliant'), a segment where buyers demand SOC 2
Press coverage notes compliance certifications are part of the trust infrastructure Grade is still building (no current SOC 2 claim found)

pitch_note: Fresh W26 fintech payroll API with only ~$500K raised and no SOC 2 badge; handles money movement and tax/compliance data, so enterprise/marketplace customers will demand SOC 2 soon. Downside: 2-person team with zero open roles, so budget and urgency may be 3-6 months out.

name: Durate

soc2_evidence.signal: Security page states: 'At Durate, we're proud to be SOC 2 Type II compliant' (HIPAA listed as 'compliance planned')

pitch_note: Disqualified for SOC 2 Type I services: already advertises SOC 2 Type II compliance on its security page. Only residual angle is their stated plan to add HIPAA compliance 'in the near future.'

name: RiskCube

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 attestation claim found for RiskCube itself on site or in search; company is an AI insurance broker handling sensitive startup financial/risk data and markets around enterprise procurement readiness (they educate customers on SOC 2 but don't claim their own)
Data policy page discusses vendor security reviews and SOC 2 in the context of customers' enterprise deals, not RiskCube's own attestation

pitch_note: Insurtech broker with no SOC 2 badge of its own, handling sensitive customer risk/financial data, and deeply fluent in the vendor-security-review world (they sell cyber insurance to startups doing SOC 2). Small 3-person team with no open roles and only ~$500K raised tempers urgency; also a natural co-marketing/referral partner rather than just a buyer.

name: Careforce

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2, HIPAA badge, trust page, or Vanta/Drata badge found anywhere on careforce.ai despite selling AI agents that access EMR/patient data for healthcare orgs
Engineering job posting has no SOC 2/HIPAA compliance mention; healthcare enterprise buyers will require both

hiring_signals: Enterprise Sales Lead (strong signal of enterprise healthcare buyers)
aws_evidence: Job post lists Python, React, FastAPI, Supabase stack; no explicit AWS/GCP/Azure mention (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/careforce-prev-helpcare-ai/jobs/Hjx9nA3-senior-fullstack-engineer)
pitch_note: Strong fit: AI agents touching EMR and patient data for healthcare orgs with zero public SOC 2/HIPAA evidence, actively hiring 4 roles including an Enterprise Sales Lead — enterprise health-system procurement will force a SOC 2 + HIPAA motion imminently. 9-person team, early-stage funding, exactly the pre-attestation window.

name: Zavo

soc2_evidence.signal: Privacy policy describes encryption, access controls, and pen testing but cites no SOC 2 or PCI DSS certification; company is a B2B payments/POS platform

aws_evidence: Privacy policy references generic 'cloud hosting, storage, database' services; only named vendors are Adyen and TrueLayer (https://zavopay.com/policies/privacy-policy)
pitch_note: Payments fintech with no SOC 2 badge, but buyers are SMB restaurants (not enterprise procurement), the company is London-based (UK market leans ISO 27001/PCI DSS over SOC 2), and there are no security/infra hires open. Weak-to-moderate fit.

name: Rovi Health

soc2_evidence.signal: Employer-facing site claims 'HIPAA-compliant infrastructure' with encryption and access controls, but no SOC 2 attestation or trust-center badge found
Sells to employers/benefits teams (enterprise buyers) handling employee health data — a segment where SOC 2 is table stakes in procurement

aws_evidence: Founding engineer post lists Python, React, TypeScript, LLM orchestration; no cloud provider named (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/rovi-health/jobs/tSysGWC-founding-engineer)
pitch_note: Strong fit: sells an AI health concierge to employers (enterprise benefits procurement + PHI), claims HIPAA-ready infrastructure but shows no SOC 2, is live with 30,000 patients, backed by Lightspeed/Gradient/Liquid 2, and is hiring multiple founding engineers. Classic pre-Type-I window where a benefits-buyer security questionnaire triggers the purchase.

name: QFEX

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2, trust page, or compliance certification found on qfex.com or in web search for a company operating a 24/7 trading exchange (heavily regulated, security-sensitive buyers)

hiring_signals: Research Engineer (London, $100K-$150K; posting mentions 'deep Kubernetes or infrastructure-as-code experience' as a plus)
aws_evidence: Job posts mention Kubernetes/IaC experience but no explicit cloud provider (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/qfex/jobs/S7XSybx-founding-backend-engineer)
pitch_note: Trading exchange with a fresh $9.5M seed (General Catalyst, just under the $10M bar), hiring backend/infra engineers, and no public SOC 2 — financial-market counterparties and institutional users will demand attestation. Caveat: London-based, so financial-services regulatory audits (FCA-style) or ISO 27001 may compete with SOC 2 for priority.

name: Claim Health

soc2_evidence.signal: No SOC 2 or HIPAA certification claim found on claimhealth.com or in press/search; platform processes claims, referral, and reimbursement data (PHI) for post-acute providers
Public job listings contain no security/compliance certifications despite revenue-cycle (claims/PHI) product

hiring_signals: Content Marketing Intern, Visual Design Intern
pitch_note: Best lead in this slice: AI revenue-cycle platform touching claims/PHI for post-acute providers, fresh $4.4M seed (Jan 2026, Maverick/Peak XV), 30x revenue growth, hiring engineers and deployment staff, and zero public SOC 2 or HIPAA attestation. Provider and payer procurement will force SOC 2 + HIPAA on them fast.
